name: Sweet Dreams
source:
A short vn horror game where you're starting to feel a bit sleepy on the train. Will you find friendship? Or will you find trouble...

[From [url=https://c2phos.itch.io/sweet-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款简短的vn恐怖游戏，你在火车上开始感到有点困。你会找到友谊吗？不然你会遇到麻烦吗…

[来自[url=https://c2phos.itch.io/sweet-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
